searchText: <@&857649635274915900> I am very sorry folks but we have to cancel today's Office Hours AMA :/ Phil had an emergency and cannot make it. Do you have anything you'd like to discuss with me and other fellows? We can still do informal office hours and chat if many of you are interested. Otherwise, we will meet next week in Cannes and Office Hours/Standups will continue the week after that. Next week we are not meeting online because we will be at the conference I am getting worried about many people choosing the same project or client team in general . This Sunday is devoted to that but if people find it beneficial I would be happy to discuss it today! Thanks for the update! I'll take the chance and use that time to keep on working on the EthCC presentation Intros with other fellows remained incomplete! I was getting to know very interesting folks. Indeed, there are many fellows looking into similar projects. There is the signaling thread so we can track it more easily https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1384203215360229458/1384203218065555619 Based on this, please reach out to fellows who are working on same or related project, create a group if there is more of you. It's important to discuss it together because each should consider 1) whether the project is the best match for your skills and area of knowledge, 2) if you are honestly motivated because you find the project interesting, right kind of challenge for you (not because it's easy or cool) 3) your long term plans, whether you are just trying to learn or seriously want to work with a client team long term I will be hanging out in the call for for 10-15 min. Join if you have anything to discuss or missed Monday. https://meet.ethereum.org/epf-office-hours https://tenor.com/view/lucy-listen-peanuts-charlie-brown-lucy-van-pelt-gif-17862164 Hi <@686695036733227017> is it possible to connect me to someone at Grandine's team to know more about what existing works have been done around DVT and what Grandine is expecting for the project Grandine: Exploring Distributed Validator Technology (DVT) Compatibility Have you joined the Grandine server? They have a channel dedicated to EPF fellows. You can ask there https://discord.gg/PrsWeg7W Hi @Mario Havel is it possible to Have you joined the Grandine server?
